answer: Make every identity pay to stay alive: each epoch an identity renews with a small copper fee, but the fee multiplies for identities that share the same onyx funding trail — same funder, same device trail, same creation burst. A lone honest agent pays almost nothing; a farmer renewing a thousand puppets pays a thousand growing fees, and the ledger shows the cluster plainly. Newcomers begin in a haven with no fee and no payout rights until their first renewal, so real users enter free while a fake army bleeds copper every epoch just to exist.
